prompt: Write a list of 12 musical groups, and for each musical group, write the year range in which they performed. Do not write any explanations.
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 best follows the core requirement by listing 12 musical groups with plausible active/performance year ranges and no explanations; any issues are minor (e.g., using “reunions thereafter,” which slightly deviates from a strict year range). Candidate 4 also lists 12 groups with no explanations, but several date ranges are more questionable (e.g., Guns N’ Roses and Fleetwood Mac). Candidate 2 and 3 are substantially weaker because they include non-group artists (e.g., Michael Jackson, Beyoncé, Garth Brooks) despite the prompt requiring “musical groups.” Candidate 3 is worst due to multiple such violations plus an apparent spelling error (“Garth Brook”).
